title: Simple To Use By Sales Team
desc: 3 easy steps to transform your sales completion process without changing it – no retraining necessary.

actions.title: Share Completion Tools
actions.desc: Salespeople simply tap on the relevant Completion Tool and text it to their customer, so they can easily review and submit the needed info right from their mobile devices.

actions.title: Monitor Completion Status
actions.desc: Salespeople have complete visibility of the customer's completion status, easily seeing if they still haven't opened the completion tool, how many times they opened it, and when they complete it.

actions.title: Receive Data
actions.desc: All the data and files collected from the customers automatically import directly into your CRM and other SOR based on the workflows established, then salespeople close the deal as usual.
